mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (indicating monetary easing) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) in periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.5%, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger risk-off sentiment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals an imminent economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) in periods when both GDPC1 and INDPRO decline by at least 0.5% quarter-over-quarter.

mechanism_narrative: During housing market contractions (HOUST below 1000 thousand units), declining home construction activity signals reduced consumer spending and economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when HOUST falls below 1000 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) in periods when PAYEMS increases by at least 100 thousand over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the core consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) rises above 3.0% year-over-year, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a monetary policy response to a labor market downturn, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing amid labor market weakness
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) in periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points and UNRATE rises by at least 0.3 percentage points over the prior 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of industrial slowdown (INDPRO below 100), declining manufacturing activity signals reduced economic output, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100.
